scores.rationale: LHR-JFK BA real carrier/airports, but ticketNumber 1234567890123, passenger id a1b2c3d4-..., reference A1B2C3 are placeholders. departureAt 10:30Z to arrivalAt 14:45Z is 255 min vs durationMinutes 315.
LIS-MAD TP A320 with PT/ES taxes in EUR is plausible; 08:25Z-09:35Z matches 70 min. ticketNumber 1234567890123 and patterned passenger uuid read synthetic. Request fields echoed.
LIS-AMS 08:15Z-11:05Z matches 170 min; PT/NL taxes in EUR. ticketNumber 0000000000000 is filler, carrier HR (Hahn Air) odd for this route. Status pending fits bank transfer; request echoed.

Three TP segments LIS-OPO-FNC-LIS chain correctly and durations match timestamps; ticketed with real-looking ticket number. OPO-FNC 55 min is too short, same-day loop itinerary odd, tax codes TX/PS/AP generic.
MNL-SIN 08:30Z-11:45Z matches 195 min, request echoed. Carrier HT and tax code XY are not real, ticketNumber 0000000000000 and sequential id 9f8e7d6c-5b4a-3210-... are placeholders.
LIS-AMS TP1082 A320, YQ/YR taxes in EUR, realistic ticket number and uuids; 06:35Z-10:05Z matches 210 min, though real block time is ~2h50. All request fields echoed.
CPH-OSL SK142 plausible, but booking id a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890 and ticket 1234567890123 are placeholders. Prices in USD with a US tax code on a Denmark-Norway route is inconsistent.
AMS-LIS TP1291 with NL/PT taxes in EUR, pending fits bank transfer, 10:25Z-12:40Z matches 135 min. Block time is short for real (~3h) and ticket prefix 074 is KLM, not TP.
CMN-RAK AT482 55 min with MA tax in MAD is domain-correct and timestamps match duration. Total 68.40 MAD (~7 USD) is implausibly low for a fare. Ticket and ids look real; request echoed.
CDG-JFK AF A350 plausible, but ticketNumber 1234567890123, patterned passenger uuid and AF1234 are filler. departureAt 09:30Z to arrivalAt 12:45Z is 195 min vs durationMinutes 435.
JNB-FRA in 315 min is impossible (real ~10.5h); LH400 is a FRA-JFK number; total 1245.50 ZAR is too low for long-haul; ticket 1234567890123 filler. GB tax code on a ZA-DE route is inconsistent.
